# Isvena

> Isvena is a leather goods house making hand-braided, vegetable-tanned (chrome-free) totes, slings, crossbody bags, clutches and baskets. Every piece is made to order by artisans in the family workshop of P.M. Rahamathulla & Co. in Periyamet, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, and shipped worldwide. The family's leather heritage dates back to 1936.

## Key facts

- Brand: Isvena
- Parent / workshop: P.M. Rahamathulla & Co.
- Founded (leather heritage): 1936; direct-to-consumer brand launched 2016
- Location: No: 16/14, M.V. Badran Street, Periyamet, Chennai 600 003, Tamil Nadu, India
- GST: 33ATYPS6349H1ZV
- Email: hello@isvena.com
- Ships: Worldwide, from Chennai, India
- Payment: Secure card payment via Stripe
- Production: Made to order; typically ships in 2–3 weeks
- Signature technique: Hand-braiding — full-grain hide cut into strips (as fine as 4mm) and woven entirely by hand
- Materials: Vegetable-tanned, chrome-free full-grain leather (safe for skin, biodegradable, develops a patina)
- Website: https://www.isvena.com

## What "vegetable-tanned, chrome-free" means

Isvena leather is tanned with natural plant tannins instead of chromium salts. It contains no heavy metals, is safe to wear against the skin, is less likely to cause allergic reactions, is fully biodegradable, and develops a rich patina with age.

## Product categories

- Hand-Braided Totes — the signature line; open carryalls and laptop totes
- Sling & Crossbody — compact hands-free braided slings, crossbody and waist bags
- Baskets & Home — leather baskets and structured box bags
- Clutches & Potli — clutch purses, braided clutches, traditional potli bags

## Brand history

- 1936 — Founder P.M. Rahmathulla begins as an apprentice leather trader in British Colombo.
- 1944 — Starts his own tanning operation.
- 1950 — PMR & Co established.
- 1966 — Registers a trademark to export vegetable-tanned cow hides; success in the UK and Italy.
- 1990 — India bans export of vegetable-tanned leather, ending that chapter.
- 2000 — The family returns to the Chennai leather trade as wholesaler, exporter and importer.
- 2016 — P.M. Rahamathulla & Co. is founded in Periyamet, Chennai as a manufacturer of finished goods; Isvena becomes its direct-to-consumer brand.
